Package com.github.gumtreediff.actions

Interface TreeClassifier

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractITreeClassifier, AllNodesClassifier, OnlyRootsClassifier
public interface TreeClassifier
An interface to partition the nodes of an AST into sets of updated, deleted, moved, and updated nodes.
